I'm a senior lecturer with the Department of Multilingualism
at the University of Fribourg,
with a focus on quantitative research methods.

I [blog](archive.qmd) about research design and statistics,
often using examples from language-learning research.

::: {.callout-note}
## Methods support and training
I offer statistical consulting, departmental methods support,
and courses on quantitative methodology, research design,
and data analysis.

[Support and consulting](support.qmd) | [Courses](courses.qmd)
:::
